page.layout: Two parallel columns of index entries under the running title "INDEX:" at the top. Left column: entries from "tūm" to "magistratus tantum an-". Right column: entries from "nui institui" to "Manfredi interitum à pontifice". The right column's last line runs on at the foot, with the signature "r 2" at its left.

page.notes: The two columns are set side by side, so each line pairs left and right entries. The left column's last line ("magistratus tantum an-") and the right column's last line ("Manfredi interitum à pontifice") both end mid-word or mid-phrase at the foot of the scan. The word "sere" in "Magiæ studiosi sere" may carry an accent over the e; I could not confirm it, so I have not marked it. The page has no page number and no catchword. "r 2" is a gathering signature, not text.
